plus12_buckboost.wiring: L1 SW1-SW2; C10 BOOT1-SW1, C9 BOOT2-SW2; MODE/EXTVCC/VCC + C82 (FPWM, internal LDO); DITH/AGND AGND_U2, PGND GND; R113 sole join at C82; R110 FSW; VOUT/ISP -> R109 -> +12V/ISN; FB R8 (+12V) / R9; COMP R111 + C83; PG/CC/CDC open; EN/UVLO = MAIN_OK
plus12_buckboost.reverse_blocking: none (owner decision S9.0): no ideal-diode controller or series FET; R109 is the only series element (current sense, inside the converter)

reverse_current.decision: ACCEPTED architecture: no series reverse blocking (owner). S9.1 removes the self-enable defect in hardware; that defect is NOT an accepted event.
reverse_current.rule: No powered parallel supplies or unrestricted hotplug. Unpowered/latched-off injection is qualified ONLY under T1 conditions, not a procedural excuse for self-enabling.

plus12_path.power_stage: Disabled four-switch boost HS blocks bus-to-VIN power transfer; divider current/leakage and capacitor charging remain.

minus12_passive.fast_step_residual: D24 forward/internal diodes can clamp around -1.4V, outside U2 -0.3V minimum. D25 reduces it but is NOT guaranteed below 0.3V at high current/cold. Unrestricted hard hotplug remains UNQUALIFIED and is not a passing acceptance test.

minus12_active.finding: FIXED: Q1 emitter is own VPD; base sink requires RUN AND MAIN_LED_OK through Q14/Q15. R112 defaults off. Bus voltage alone cannot enable U4.
minus12_active.enabled_parallel_risk: FPWM still sinks if enabled against a higher external rail. -0.9A is TYPICAL only, not a worst-case bound; no finite-energy TVS can absorb an unlimited live bus.

enable_logic.logic: QUALIFY = RUN AND MAIN_LED_OK = RUN AND MAIN_OK AND V20_OK; Q14 and Q15 series sink
enable_logic.drive_source: Q1 emitter VPD upstream of D10; never +12V or VIN
enable_logic.equation: EN_N - V(-12V) = QUALIFY ? (VPD - VCEsat - V(-12V))*R18/(R17+R18) : Ileak*R18
enable_logic.off_pullup: R112 ties Q1 base to VPD if either sink is off; R18 pulls EN to U4 ground
enable_logic.supply_loss_response: MAIN_OK has falling deglitch; until it drops a powered converter can sink a bus. Clamp test bounds that finite interval; never parallel a running module.

pulse_budget.basis: Finite 1A x 26V x 20ms engineering budget. Datasheet pulse curve screen ~100W at 20ms after 50C derating; 600W rating applies ONLY to 10/1000us. No universal joule rating or continuous 26W claim.

D24.protects: U2 VIN/SW1 42V abs /36V operating; 50V VIN bank and C25/C26 (26+12.6=38.6V); U5 OUT 60V
D24.limitations: Rated clamp is at 25C and specified waveform, not a measured PCB spike bound. Qualified fixture requires VIN<28V incl ringing at 25/50C. Sustained enabled reverse power is NOT safe.

D25.scope: Bus slew <=1 V/s at 25C (<=26.5uA displacement current from 2x10u+100n rated high C). Not a cold/fast-hotplug clamp.

D26.protects: U2 VOUT/SW2/ISP/ISN 25V abs and local 25V MLCCs; not a 16V downstream guarantee
D26.limitations: Finite pulse backstop only; external rail source must be removed by fixture. No fuse coordination / crowbar or sustained shunt claim.

conditions: T1-A: no USB input, +/-12.0 and +/-12.6V external bus, 1A source limit, 0.44mF each rail; ramp <=1V/s at 25C, hold 10s; log EN_N relative to -12V, U4 SW, VIN and bus currents
T1-B: same with USB present and FAULT latched/RUN low; verify off-state once MAIN_OK deglitch expires and capture the preceding <=20ms interval
T1-C: only negative rail applied with same bounded slew; repeat rail order

T1-D: inject a positive 1A, <=20ms pulse into VIN (compliance 28V, automatic disconnect), 25/50C, >=200s between pulses. This separately tests D24 energy/clamp; never assume the now-disabled U4 will generate this pulse
pass_criteria: T1-A/C: EN_N minus -12V <=0.11V settled (<=0.5V transient), zero U4 switching; VIN -0.3..1V after 100ms settled; each bus current <10mA after 100ms
T1-B: same EN/switching/current criteria after 20ms; VIN may retain own-input charge, must remain -0.3..28V, not climb from bus power
T1-D: VIN <=28V incl ringing, measured integral(V*I*dt)<=0.52J, clamp current ends by 20ms, no leakage increase >10uA after cooling; normal restart and regulation after RESET
All: automatic overvoltage disconnect at VIN 28V, negative excursion abort at -0.3V (fast comparator, not human reaction). An abort is a FAIL, not a pass.
bench_test.excluded: Hard hotplug, temperatures below25C for D25 forward-drop guarantee, >1A or >20ms sustained injection, and powered parallel supplies require new protection/qualification.

rail_overvoltage.decision: ACCEPTED architecture: no voltage-triggered fuse/crowbar; crowbar vs eFuse deferred/open. S9.1 D26 is a finite-energy transient backstop, not continuous shunt protection.
rail_overvoltage.response: U20 presets FAULT and opens U5; it does NOT disconnect an external rail source or immediately discharge stored energy.
why_no_fuse: A fuse responds to current, not voltage.
D24/D26 TVS pulse ratings do not authorize sustained reverse power.
rail_overvoltage.limitations: Energy screens are NOT guaranteed peaks. Internal U2 OVP 24.5V is never used as an ideal clamp. No-load output can exceed16V; -12V has no positive-magnitude clamp. Unrelated failed-short components and unlimited external supplies are excluded.

conditions: T2-A: input16.5V; 0.44mF +0.5A/rail; externally ramp +12V from12 to16.5V at<=1V/ms, <=1A, total injection<=10ms (including ramp), hold<=1ms at16.5V; fixture removes injection automatically after trigger; scope>=100MS/s
T2-B: R8 open at13.5/16.5V input, 3A source; no external C/no load, then0.44mF+0.5A; capture500ms with independent voltage/current abort
T2-C: R14 open, same conditions; no assumed LMR38020 output OVP
T2-D: RUN held low/logic powered, +14.0V and -13.0V external for10min; safely BELOW the minimum guard thresholds; no-trip only refers to OV_N, not RUN
T2-E: at+15.2V / -13.9V a trip is ALLOWED (inside tolerance bands); repeat guaranteed trip at+15.8V / -14.5V with <=1V/ms slew, <=1A source and >=50us hold (record actual waveform)
pass_criteria_this_module: With >=0.5V rail overdrive beyond each measured trip, OV_N low/FAULT set/RUN low <=20us; MAIN LED off. Keep FAULT latched10s after injection removed, reset explicitly only after fault repair

Externally driven rail remains externally driven until fixture removal: NEVER require it off while injection remains. After removal connect1k/1W discharge load; both rails below1V within2s at <=0.44mF external C

T2-B/C: observed positive rail peak<=24.0V and negative magnitude<=24.0V for the500ms capture; positive duration above16V<=100ms with specified1k discharge; D26 pulse energy<=0.10J; normal regulation after repair/RESET

T2-D OV_N stays high. T2-E band points may trip or not; above-band points MUST trip. Automatic abort at+24V / -24V / VIN28V, source removed in<=2us; any abort fails qualification, no human-only protection
downstream_qualification: Without a separate rail protector, downstream modules must tolerate16.5V/10s and sub-threshold +15.3V/-14.1V continuously, and up to24V magnitude/100ms or their measured actual exposure if worse. Ordinary16V caps are NOT thereby qualified; incompatible modules excluded until crowbar/eFuse decision.

startup_qualification.meaning: 3 A source limiting MUST be tested; output CC does not enforce the PD input contract. Energy times are lower bounds, not startup guarantees.

matrix.condition: Cold start, 14.25 V source +0.25 ohm cable, exact 3.00 A constant-current limit; 0/0.44 mF external each rail; 0/15/25/33 W load; both delay corners; log all attempts
matrix.pass: Single attempt: both rail monitors good within 250 ms of first enable; ARMED by 0.90 s; no V3V3/POR reset, no source restart, <=3.00 A steady input; no retry hidden from record

matrix.condition: Same loads with a PD source hard-resetting on >3 A; include 5 V phase and V3V3 fully collapsed to 0 V
matrix.pass: A single hard reset is counted and disqualifies that source/load combination for guaranteed start; no success by discarding earlier failed attempts

matrix.condition: Persistent rail short, uninterrupted source, then manual RESET and separate full power removal/reapplication
matrix.pass: Each power epoch with input held must fault within 0.90 s+2 ms of first enable, hold RUN low until explicit reset, and fault again with short present

matrix.condition: Ten automatic input hard resets every 200 ms while short remains, V3V3 collapsed in each off interval
matrix.pass: Qualification result must be FAIL_REPEATED_POWER_RESET, never a pass from a final successful cycle; fixture latches power OFF on the second autonomous reset

startup_qualification.power_reset_policy: STARTED and FAULT are volatile. Full V3V3/POR loss legitimately clears both; S8.5 one-shot preserved, not falsely advertised as nonvolatile. Automatic retrying sources are outside qualified envelope. Fixture counts epochs and must stop retries; hardware nonvolatile lockout remains absent.
startup_qualification.bench_status: NOT PERFORMED; source/load qualification is open

spare_comparators.U20: out 1 open: - REF_OV, + MON_OVN; out 13 open: - REF_OV, + GND

startup_arming.topology: STARTED = U12 A (PRE_N = START_N = NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, RUN), CLR_N = RESET_N, CLK low); TIMER_GO = RUN AND STARTED; ARMED = U11 output

requirements.R1: bounded arming: converters enabled and unarmed only within the U11 delay after the first enable since RESET
requirements.R2: no restart: ARMED rises once per RESET, t_d after the first enable, whatever MAIN_OK/VPD/rails do
requirements.R3: no early arming: never before a genuine converter enable (U5 on with valid status); the PD 5 V phase cannot start it
requirements.R4: fail-safe: after ARMED any bad status > ~1 ms latches FAULT; FAULT keeps RUN low until RESET; OV_N presets FAULT at any time

cold_start_worst_loaded_15V.why: 15 V PD source at -5 % (14.25 V unloaded, U5 turns on at its 13.98 V maximum), 13.5 V loaded after the start; MAIN_OK floats high during the 5 V phase

slow_PD_contract_2s5.why: 5 V phase longer than the qualification window, U5 status floating high (S8.4 armed here and latched off before the PD voltage arrived)

brownout_after_ARMED.why: VPD sags to 10.5 V (below the 11.55 V U5 turn-off minimum, above the 9.27 V V20_OK maximum) for 50 ms after ARMED (U5 off), recovers; RESET pressed later

brownout_inside_window.why: VPD sags to 10.5 V for 50 ms right after the first enable; the window is NOT restarted

input_overload_chatter.why: U5 current limit / auto-retry: on 30 ms, off 20 ms, forever (S8.4: timer restarted every cycle, never armed)

hot_plug_live_bus.why: outputs plugged into a bus another supply already holds inside the monitor windows: the rail monitors read good from 0 ms; nothing else reaches the logic

load_release_after_ARMED.why: +/-12V load released after ARMED: the release peak stays below the U20 guard minimum (calcs ov_guard) and the rails stay above their monitor thresholds, so no logic input changes (the run must stay armed without a FAULT)

load_release_inside_window.why: the same +/-12V load release during the qualification window

ov_guard_before_ARMED.why: +12V or -12V beyond the U20 guard 60 ms after the first enable: OV_N low for 1 ms

short_RESET_while_running.why: RESET pulse of the 12 ms POR minimum while PGOOD (13 ms falling-deglitch screen) is still high when RESET releases

source_limit_3A.why: Ideal 3A budget allocation, 0.0954J bank/rack charging with0.818W remaining at33W load. Not proof of actual CC arbitration; bench S1 required

power_reset_rearm_persistent_short.why: Persistent short; fault must latch in EACH of two power epochs. V3V3 fully lost, POR re-arms legitimately; original failed epoch is retained

repeated_power_reset_rejected.why: Adversarial source resets before ARMED; volatile STARTED clears. Logic semantics expected, but external qualification MUST reject repeated resets, never report success

scenarios: STARTED survives MAIN_OK drops (no restart); armed + MAIN_OK low -> FAULT clock
MAIN_OK floating high with V20_OK low (PD 5 V phase) does not start the window
warnings: Arithmetic stacks every tolerance at once; it is a screen, not a rating.
Digital truth checks and the arming timelines use datasheet timings; they do not model analog propagation, comparator/LED timing or MOSFET transients.
